issues.description: push_error called with a string kwarg but likely expects an ErrorFrame
issues.detail: All six reviewers flagged that push_error(error_msg=...) probably doesn't match the FrameProcessor base class signature, which expects an ErrorFrame instance. The original code had this latent bug, but the consolidation routes many new error types through the same call, amplifying the blast radius. Verify the signature against the base class before merge.

issues.description: Duplicate 'transcriber_error' entry in the error message_type tuple
issues.detail: All six reviewers noted that 'transcriber_error' appears twice in the tuple. Harmless at runtime but signals a copy-paste error and suggests the list wasn't carefully cross-checked against ElevenLabs docs, raising the possibility that another intended error type was omitted. Deduplicate and verify completeness.

issues.description: Per-type logger.error calls dropped in consolidation, reducing observability
issues.detail: The previous code logged distinct messages (ElevenLabs auth error, Quota exceeded) at error level before pushing the frame. The unified branch removes these logger.error calls, so operators tailing logs lose visibility into specific error categories. Restore a logger.error including message_type before push_error.

issues.description: Removing the outer try/except may propagate non-disconnect exceptions in unexpected ways
issues.detail: The previous wrapper swallowed all exceptions from _process_messages and logged a warning, letting websocket_service reconnect cleanly. Now any exception (ConnectionClosed, transient parse errors, handler bugs) propagates to the caller. Confirm the websocket_service reconnect loop treats arbitrary exceptions as reconnect triggers rather than fatal task crashes or tight-looping.

issues.description: Generic 'Error:' prefix loses semantic distinction between error categories downstream
issues.detail: All error variants now produce f'Error: {error_msg}' regardless of category (auth, quota, rate_limited, etc.). Downstream consumers of error frames can no longer differentiate auth failures from quota issues without parsing the payload. Include message_type in the pushed error string for triage.

changelog/3233.fixed.md ends without a final newline. Minor POSIX hygiene issue but easy to fix; some changelog aggregation tools can merge two bullets onto one line when concatenating fragments without trailing newlines.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR correctly identifies and fixes a real bug — the inner try/except in _receive_messages was swallowing websocket disconnect exceptions and causing an infinite reconnect loop — and broadens error-type coverage in a useful way. However, the consolidation introduces several quality regressions: a duplicated 'transcriber_error' entry, loss of per-type logger.error calls (observability regression), and a generic 'Error:' prefix that drops semantic context downstream. All reviewers flag that push_error's signature (string kwarg vs ErrorFrame) needs verification against the base class. Direction is sound; tighten error reporting, dedupe the tuple, and confirm exception propagation behavior before merge.
